{{Quote|The stage is set. Activate the ray shield." <br /> "Copy that, General Skywalker.|Anakin Skywalker and this security guard|<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''security guard''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] visited the planet to preside over a public ceremony, the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. Before the Chancellor's speech, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] contacted this [[Security Guard/Legends|guard]] and bid him to activate a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] to protect the Chancellor during his speech, in which the guard willingly obliged.
